title: Ghostcast
summary: Go live to an AI chat audience that reacts to your voice, camera, and stream moments.
homeBlurb: Ghostcast imagines a livestream with an AI audience that responds to voice, camera, and the rhythm of the room.
description: Ghostcast is a pretend livestream: turn on your camera and mic, then watch an AI-written audience react to what you say and show. Nothing is broadcast to other people.
The chat has its own rhythm, emotes, and reactions to stream events, so it feels lively even when you pause.

title: God Is a Dick: SINfully Good
summary: A satirical cookbook of spectacularly, unapologetically non-kosher food.
homeBlurb: God Is a Dick: SINfully Good turns forbidden pairings into a full satirical cookbook.
description: A 120-page cookbook with 45 recipes that break the rules on purpose: bacon-fat challah French toast, lobster gefilte fish, cheeseburger bourekas, and plenty more.
The writing pairs Jewish food traditions with irreverent humor and practical cooking. Made with Claude and ChatGPT.

title: Dirhaven
summary: Explore your filesystem as a pixel-art town where folders become places and files become objects.
homeBlurb: Dirhaven makes a filesystem walkable, giving folders streets and files things to discover.
description: Dirhaven turns folders into districts, buildings, and rooms. Walk the map, open files as books, pictures, video, or music, and meet residents with errands that lead you through the tree.
The world is generated deterministically without an LLM, and files are read only when you choose to open them. The linked demo uses a made-up sample folder. Made with Claude.

title: Sunder
summary: Scan a receipt, split the items fairly, and keep track of who has paid.
homeBlurb: Sunder brings the group back to earth, scanning receipts and finding fair shares.
description: Sunder extracts receipt items, lets people claim quantities or split by percentage and custom amounts, then calculates balances and tracks payments.
Shared links let a group participate without each person setting up an account. Built with Manus.
